name: v134_mna_bam_no_social_iv
hypothesis: Fast M&A acceptance news may capture a different event-digestion path than the existing social/IV-skew sleeve if social, PCR, breakeven, and IV terms are removed.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20) < 0.62, 0.420 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bam_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_merger_acquisition_sentiment, 90), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry) + 0.110 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.100 * rank(-(close / open - 1)), -1)
notes: Repair seed: 0m7NKnR1 was strong but too close to RRplYRpo. This removes social_value, buzz, and IV-skew terms; strict-check against e7OQoveE.

name: v134_ppe_age_no_issuance
hypothesis: Aged capital stock with restrained PPE expansion can proxy for disciplined reinvestment quality, distinct from annual total-assets and EBIT delivery.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.42, 0.430 * group_rank(ts_rank(accumulated_depreciation_depletion_amortization_ppne / ppe_gross_value, 126), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ppe_gross_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(ppe_gross_value / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.110 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Repair seed: QPaWZ39X had good metrics but high corr to issuance/dilution. This removes explicit correlation relief and avoids issuance fields.

name: v134_employee_sbp_pure_burden
hypothesis: Lower employee benefit liabilities and share-based compensation burden can represent cleaner human-capital cost structure, especially when not mixed with value/EBITDA legs.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.38, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_compensation_cost_nonvested_awards / sales, 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * share_award_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(debt_extinguishment_gain_loss_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-(close / open - 1)), -1)
notes: Repair seed: A1wQr2QQ had value legs and correlated with FCF/value actives. This tests the compensation parent alone; strict-check against omKoPEb6, LLpKELr9, and akda9EW9.

name: v134_customer_count_signal_no_auth

name: v134_repurchase_authorization_low_dilution

notes: Uses low-alphaCount authorization/reacquired-share fields rather than common_stock_buyback_payments. Strict-check against MPpGzqwr, 88zpWZ1X, KPbgz6xp, and j2ZaGlVE.
